intent_en: To explain the profit distribution and accounting breakdown of a pirate raid among investors, port officials, and the attacking crew.
previous_intent: To explain the profit distribution model of pirate expeditions, detailing the portions allocated to investors, port fees, and crew bounties.
narration_support: First investors get their guaranteed cut of at least 30%. The port who looked the other way while they parked the ship gets 5-10% and the rest is split between the attackers
chart_support: Donut chart showing the proportional allocation of loot to investors, port fees, and bounties
evidence_note: The narration details the specific percentages and bonus amounts for the accounting split, while the chart visualizes the main components (investors, port fees, bounties) and the bonus amount.
